purpose: Test whether seven historical conditional TrackMan deviations add stable information to the strongest credible TabM success-call outcome parent.

novelty_audit.exact_tabm_parent: v4_tabm_enhanced_successcall_all already includes overall rich TrackMan, stability, full current state, X, and H1
novelty_audit.existing_conditional_trackman: count and platoon profiles were tested in CatBoost and the new low-capacity HGB, but never in TabM outcome
novelty_audit.external_research_boundary: Public implementations motivated retaining only speed and pitch-mix deviations. No external data, model, prediction, or copied source code is used.

data_rules.history_rule: TrackMan profiles and target labels use seasons strictly before the target year

exact_parent.drop_features: exact parent list plus the preregistered conditional exclusions below

development_gate.uncertainty: pitcher-cluster bootstrap 95% interval with 1000 fixed-seed replicates
requirements: positive R point gain over exact TabM parent in both 2022 and 2023
positive R 95% gain lower bound over exact TabM parent in both 2022 and 2023
positive R point gain over exact C and both honest R anchors in both 2022 and 2023
development_gate.on_pass: freeze the exact recipe and run 2024 once
